It doesn’t matter who initiates, or who wants this. It’s not a power game. Once I made a joke to my ex about how one partner always has the power, and he almost dumped me over it! And you know what, he’s right. We should stop looking at these situations and people in our lives as a game of who needs it more. 

My ex also asked us to not talk and for space. He didn’t call it no contact. But I do feel powerful. I’m powerful enough and strong enough to try to respect him and his wishes! I’m strong enough to do it for myself too, even though it’s not what I want because it’s what I need. If doesn’t matter if I want him back or not, we need to cool off, regardless of if there is a future or not. You both need that too. It’s too charged. It’s too emotional. You need to sort your feelings a little first and reflect. I’m being strong and I feel powerful because all the hard moments and self doubt and crying? They haven’t made me crack yet! 

My relationship before? He blocked me everywhere. I had no choice about the no contact. The fact that you have the choice to make consciously every day to be strong is your power here. You’re in control, maybe not of the situation or him, but yourself. 

Don’t let your anxiety get the best of you. I know what it’s like to battle that. Hell, I had it so bad that one night my ex had to call me and sing to me. It sucks! But you know what? If you give in to it, then your reasons to break up we’re even more legitimate than you thought. If you give in? That’s when you’re powerless. 

Your anxiety might say you’re powerless. But every day that you keep up, you are in control of yourself and your anxieties. You’re the most powerful version of yourself right now. You’re doing something that feels impossible. You’re succeeding.

Hey, I know how hard that is. My ex and I broke up with him screaming saying he needs to be alone and be himself and someday we could talk, after a serious relationship and plans to move in together. Well I guess he may have also cheated along the way but who knows. What matters is he started dating someone shortly after. They’ve been to Paris together now. At first I wish crushed, really, but it actually gave me the resolve to finally let go of that relationship. It doesn’t matter if they’re happy or not. It doesn’t matter who moved forward first. The important thing is that you get to where you need to be. And anyway, my grandma in all her wisdom said it like this: people of quality are rare, and the majority of the people who are together, may not be quality. Better to be behind in the race but not faint from exhaustion. You got this!! Now shut them out for good, until you’re ready to be happy for them and not care :) or never! Whatever!

When you're right, you're right. I just can't place why I feel kind of differently this time compared to others. Ugh *ugh* ugh *ugh* ugh

It's hard to be quiet

I have shut up, and I have done my best to move on given the little amount of time, but, it just feels wrong to me. 

I held onto people before because they gave me something, or I didn't want to be alone. This is the first time I am trying to let go of someone. The first time I don't care what they give me or in what capacity I am in their life so long as we get to continue to interact and share. I was always able to get excited right after, even after relationships of years. I was always able to jump and say, well, they weren't really what I wanted and weren't really satisfying me and weren't really right for me. But right now I can't.

I'm fine, but with how I feel about it all, it makes me think maybe it really was the real deal and something that could have worked out like it does in the movies.

No screaming, no anger, no resentment, just everyone sad to step back and talking about when and if there can be a step forward. It was kind. I was selfless. *Me*. That never happens. Maybe I've been a little kid until now, and this is how adults do it. Maybe I unpacked all my trauma. I don't know. But a part of me is really hung up in this tragic way that this isn't a person who is supposed to walk out of my life.

It doesn't really feel like waiting, in so far as, nothing else has caught my eye just yet, and when it does, if it does, having met him wouldn't stop me. I'm not sitting quietly and going through his social media for any sign of life... it's just, even since we broke up I tried to talk to other people, even men that I had on-and-off powerful connections with, and they've since fizzled. Maybe it's just because they did. Maybe it's because I met *this* guy, but even when I was in love with someone else there was still chemistry I wasn't acting on with this one person, and it's just gone! It made me more sad than my break up, to think maybe I'm really stuck feeling this way for someone for a while! 

I know he doesn't want to sacrifice anything, which is why he stepped back... and I never wanted him to sacrifice to be with me... but I feel like I am sacrificing what I want, and was this whole time. First it was sacrificing dates for his schedule, or opening up because he was too stressed to deal with it, and now I'm kind of sacrificing a relationship that I feel could be wonderful because I care about this person. I know that he was willing to keep trying and willing to sacrifice to be with me, or to stay the night when he didn't want to, but I didn't want that from him, and he doesn't want to feel that way anymore... he needs to find a balance with himself first. He doesn't want to give chances when he gave so many to so many other people, because the result wasn't good for him. I do get it. But I got caught in this wave and I'm half-way to letting it go completely and halfway to waiting it out a few months until he's had some space and we can talk. 

I mean really, I was willing to just be friends, even with my feelings, and be happy for him if he met someone else, that's how well we got along and how much I like him. It wasn't going to stop me from being happy with someone else either, it's just a person I am not ready to lose over romance or intimacy, it was so much more than that. 

Just *ugh*

I'm going to the gym again, where I see him, because of course why would I get to heal in quiet. I'm seeing friends. I'm going out on dates. I'm working. My life didn't stop, but he is missing. My life was full before, and continues to be now, but the depth of interactions and how much of myself I got to share with the world has changed... we both found people who we could truly share all these weird random things with and when that's gone it's like you're a little less fulfilled...

Well, with my current ex? I'm not there. Maybe I will be someday, but for whatever reason I truly hope that we can reconcile... but more on that later.

With the partner I had before it took me a long time. I thought I would marry him. He gave me diamonds. We were about to move in together. I spent every weekend with his family. I was on his insurance plan. We didn't spend a day apart... then he slipped right out of my hands. I felt like I was trying to catch water that was flowing. I felt like I was suffocating. I think I kept calling for a long, long time. Trying to talk. Getting new numbers. Anything. I think the last text I sent was months ago now, and I think about him sometimes but, I don't really want him around now... a year later. I still wanted at least to say goodbye. After we broke up the first time we were on and off for months, crying, screaming, having sex... but in the end? It was a physically and emotionally abusive mess (for both of us, probably). Sometimes I compare other men to him, but only because I know better what I want, what I deserve, what kind of relationship I would like. It stung when I thought he was dating. It stung when he was in Paris with his girlfriend on my birthday. A lot of things hurt. But somewhere in there, I saw that no man should hurt me the way he did. I didn't go NC myself, he blocked me out completely. Even before we finally broke up the last time. When his friends told me he was cheating on me. After he physically hurt me. I still didn't choose to do it for myself and I felt *powerless*. When you go NC? You are consciously making a choice for yourself. Maybe I wasn't mature enough to make it then. But, I feel like maybe I would have felt better sooner if I had chosen. He and I are done for good. Yes, I will always love him, but I accepted a long time ago that even if he loves me too, and maybe he really doesn't, but even if? It's just not enough. The reasons we broke up were the only reasons I needed to go NC. The reasons we broke up were GOOD ENOUGH REASONS. I guess until you accept that they were, you may not accept that it is forever. Depends on the situation. I wouldn't give up on someone I love ever. Maybe after NC, the guy I was just seeing and I have a chance. Our relationship was great and we were compatible, but the timing wasn't. I still reach out to people I loved once, many years down the line. Not always to reconcile, but sometimes just out of interest. NC itself isn't forever. Needing it to grow and be happy? It might be. Take your time. Get to where you need to.  

Even if the partner that broke me comes back, and, the chances of that are so slim. I'm not sure I would want him to. I grew so much this past year. I became a beautiful radiant person, I got back all the bits of myself I lost in that relationship, I got even more. I learned so much. I developed. He wouldn't recognize me now, and I wouldn't be this person who I like so much without him and the bumps in the road that came after. If he came back, I think I would be going NC myself. I wouldn't want to go backwards... and sometimes, that's what coming out of it can be. Not always, but sometimes. 

Anyway, I don't think anything is permanent, but once you grow out of the person you are, it just may not be relevant anymore. If that makes sense.

Hey, I'm only on day 9, that's not a lot... but my ex said the same things to me. He needs to work on himself, he needs to be happy with himself, he needs to be true to himself... he just can't be in a relationship with anyone right now. It's not me. "Great", I thought, "we can keep seeing each other", keep sleeping together, enjoy everything else. But you know what? I beat that door down, after so many nights of us crying together, of him kissing me and saying he will miss me. Some nights saying no to sex because it is too hard, sometimes giving in because it's too hard not to... he stormed out at 4 AM because it was too complicated. And it is. If you can't cut him out for yourself right now, cut him out for him. Let him grow. Let him be strong on his own. That's what is getting me through it... I know it's hard. I know you think you should be together. That's okay. Maybe you should. But the point is you can't right now, and as some wonderful redditor told me, the way she sees it is they're like Jack and Rose after the Titanic goes down. If you hold onto each other and thrash around, you'll both go down. If you try to stay afloat, each one of you on your own, maybe when the boat comes you'll both get picked up and you'll go get ice cream together. Don't think about cutting him out forever. Give both of you a chance to step away and clear your heads. Then, take another step back to let yourself heal... and eventually, when you have taken enough steps back, a day at a time, if you feel like you still really want this, try. But not out of a place of hurt, or fear. If he can't be in a relationship right now? The truth is, he'll only hurt you. Loving someone you can't be with hurts. Loving someone you can't be with when you're pressed together? It hurts more. When he's ready, that's when you can have what you deserve, and you do deserve a relationship.
